anchor.note: p.124 l.Lines 30-35 read as the printed page; section 1 agrees

public.text: Temporary facilities are to receive distinct records, but the document does not describe when a temporary service should be modelled as a facility, location, service event, or extension of an existing facility.
public.suggestedRevision: Add classification rules and examples based on operational responsibility, duration, location, services, reporting needs, and the requirement for independent identity and lifecycle history.
